title: Sprint 4 - Basic Retrieval & Filtering
description: Complete all SQL queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: Fetch All Users
tickets.description: Retrieve all columns and all rows from the `users` table.
tasks: Retrieve all columns and all rows from the `users` table.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the semicolon at the end of the query.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id;

tickets.title: DISTINCT Retrieval
tickets.description: Fetch a list of all unique statuses currently present in the `todos` table.
tasks: Fetch a list of all unique statuses currently present in the `todos` table.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM todos ORDER BY status;

tickets.title: Filter Active Todos (Equality)
tickets.description: Fetch only the `title` of todos that have a status of 'pending'.
tasks: Fetch only the `title` of todos that have a status of 'pending'.
learning_objectives: Using the WHERE clause for equality.
common_mistakes: Using double quotes instead of single quotes for strings.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY title;

solution.query.sql: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE status = 'pending';

tickets.title: Comparison Operators
tickets.description: Fetch the `title` of todos that have a priority greater than 1.
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos that have a priority greater than 1.
learning_objectives: Filter data using comparison operators like >.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE priority > 1 ORDER BY title;

solution.query.sql: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE priority > 1;

tickets.title: Logical Operators (AND / OR / NOT)
tickets.description: Fetch the `title` of todos that have a priority of 3 AND status is 'pending'.
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos that have a priority of 3 AND status is 'pending'.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE priority = 3 AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY title;

solution.query.sql: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE priority = 3 AND status = 'pending';

tickets.title: The IN Operator
tickets.description: Fetch the `title` of todos where the status is IN ('pending', 'completed').
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos where the status is IN ('pending', 'completed').
learning_objectives: Filter against a list of values.
common_mistakes: Using multiple ORs instead of IN.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE status IN ('pending', 'completed') ORDER BY title;

solution.query.sql: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE status IN ('pending', 'completed');

tickets.title: The BETWEEN Operator
tickets.description: Fetch the `title` of todos where priority is BETWEEN 1 AND 3.
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos where priority is BETWEEN 1 AND 3.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE priority BETWEEN 1 AND 3 ORDER BY title;

solution.query.sql: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE priority BETWEEN 1 AND 3;

tickets.title: The LIKE Operator
tickets.description: Find all todos where the title contains the word 'database'.
tasks: Find all todos where the title contains the word 'database'.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE '%database%' ORDER BY id;

solution.query.sql: SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE '%database%';

tickets.title: IS NOT NULL
tickets.description: Fetch the `title` of todos where the due_date IS NOT NULL.
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos where the due_date IS NOT NULL.
hints: Use IS NOT NULL, not != NULL.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE due_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY title;

solution.query.sql: SELECT title FROM todos WHERE due_date IS NOT NULL;
